author: high
claim: Prove sufficiency by induction on |X|, splitting according as a nonempty proper tight set A with |N(A)|=|A| exists.
evidence: In the tight-set case, solve the induced graph on A and N(A), then the residual graph on X\A and Y\N(A); Hall for the residual follows by applying Hall to A union B.
